measure: local-lane mid-turn deaths classified from the runs' own streams

method.attempt_view: every stream.jsonl / resume-N.jsonl is one observation; a death is a stream with no top-level result record whose process is gone
method.terminal_view: only the run's last attempt is read, matching reckon.crew.death_census
method.role_source: the run's own prompt.txt ROLE line, ledger record as fallback
method.effort_source: the run's recorded ledger row (the lane pins effort)
method.effort_is_not_a_calibration_axis_here: the lane's endpoint ignores thinking budgets, so the review reflex's effort is the lane's declared one

headline.population: review role at the lane's declared review effort

review_role_all_efforts.population: review role at every declared effort

trailing_1d.population: review role at every declared effort

trailing_7d.population: review role at every declared effort

completion_control.note: same run, later attempt: the parser reads a result record where one was written, so a death reading is not the reader failing on this run

after_unavailable_reason: the repair that would create a post-repair window has not landed: the review-reliability work that owns it is declared implementable with its driving followup still open, so no attempt in the corpus ran against a repaired lane.
